summary: Caesars Entertainment filed an 8-K disclosing two Icahn Group director resignations (Jesse Lynn, Ted Papapostolou, effective September 16, 2026, with the Icahn Group waiving its replacement-director right under the March 17, 2025 Director Appointment and Nomination Agreement) and confirming FTC antitrust risk on its pending take-private. Under the May 27, 2026 merger agreement, Fertitta Entertainment's Merger Sub will merge into Caesars, leaving Caesars a wholly owned Fertitta subsidiary. Both parties received FTC Second Requests on September 14, 2026, extending the HSR waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance, unless shortened. Watch the FTC clock and any proxy-supplement developments.
